requested_params.caption: Progressive house, edm. Euphoric, emotional, uplifting. Emotional airy female vocal topline, clear words, sung in English. Bright synth lead, rich punchy electronic drums, deep synth bass, warm synth pads and pulsing synth arpeggios. Filtered beat intro, minimal verses, pre-chorus, chorus, big drop, breakdown, final chorus. Festival-ready mix, huge supersaw synths. four-on-the-floor kick, sidechain pulse, melodic instrumental drops, vocals kept out of the drops. Vocal forward, natural phrasing.
requested_params.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Gutters drip along the street
Puddles shine beneath our feet
Your collar's wet, your laugh is loud
The moon breaks through a broken cloud

[Pre-Chorus]
Thunder fades and I can breathe
Hold me close, don't let it leave

[Chorus]
After the rain, we come alive
Your hand in mine, electric skies
Puddles hold the streetlamp's light
We're awake inside the night

[Drop]

[Breakdown]
I counted seconds between the cracks
Now I'm counting your heartbeat back
Lift your face, let the light pour in
We're starting over, let it begin

[Chorus]
After the rain, we come alive
Your hand in mine, electric skies
Puddles hold the streetlamp's light
We're awake inside the night

[Drop]

[Outro]
